blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Streaming multi-reference video generation establishes a scene from specified people and objects, then continues it under changing instructions. We introduce TaoMate-R1, a streaming multi-reference generator that organizes adaptation parameters through temporal role specialization. It assigns separate low-rank adapters to scene establishment and continuation on a frozen backbone. Each adapter performs both denoising and context writing for its role; Self Gradient Forcing jointly trains the roles through the history they construct. This allocation contrasts with operation-based specialization, which separates denoising from context writing across all chunks. A fixed-replay gradient analysis characterizes the update directions admitted by the two sharing schemes. On 32 multi-reference cases, we compare the schemes at the same two-adapter budget. Across ten approximately two-minute streams with changing instructions and shared teacher-audio conditioning, TaoMate-R1 reduces the mean boundary luminance jump from 1.96 to 0.613, with higher boundary feature similarity. It also achieves higher mean CLIP and DINO temporal similarity across short interactions, long streams, and public reference compositions. These results support grouping adaptation parameters by scene establishment and continuation for streaming multi-reference generation. Our code and model are released at https://github.com/TaoLiveAIGC/TaoMate-H3.
blocks.zh: 流出多参考视频生成建立来自指定人物和对象的场景,再在更改指令下继续. 我们引入了 TaoMate-R1,通过时间作用专业化来组织适应参数的流式多参考生成器. 它为场景的建立和在被冻结的骨干上续作分配了单独的低等适配器. 每个适配器都为它的角色进行去名和上下文的写作; 自渐强化联合训练它们所构建的历史中的角色. 这种分配与基于操作的专门化形成对比,后者将所有块的上下文书写区分开来。 固定重放梯度分析是两个共享方案所接受的更新方向的特点。 关于32个多参考案例,我们比较了两个适应预算的方案。 TaoMate-R1将平均边界亮度跳跃从1.96降至0.613,其边界特征更为相似。 它还在短相互作用、长流和公共参考构成方面实现了更高的平均CLIP和DINO时间相似性。 这些结果支持按照场景建立和延续来分组适应参数,以便流出多参考生成. 我们的代码和模型在https://github.com/TaoLiveAIGC/TaoMate-H3上发布.

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Multi-reference video generation specifies the people and objects in a scene through images.
Models such as Phantom, VACE, and MiniMax-H3 compose these visual conditions into video clips [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] .
Streaming extends the task to an evolving scene: a presenter introduces a cup, puts it away, and picks up a bag as new instructions arrive.
The desired behavior combines change with persistence.
The current instruction determines the interaction, while the generated past determines its starting state.
blocks.zh:
多参考视频生成通过图像指定一个场景中的人和对象.
Phantom,VACE,和MiniMax-H3等模型将这些视觉条件组成了视频剪辑[1,2,3].
流出将任务延伸至一个不断发展的场景:一个介绍者介绍一个杯子,把它收起,并随着新指示的到来而取出一个包.
所期望的行为结合了变化和持久性.
当前指令决定交互,而生成的过去则决定其起始状态.

blocks.en:
The opening and subsequent chunks therefore solve different conditional tasks.
At the opening, the generator chooses how reference appearances are realized through pose, placement, and initial motion.
During continuation, those realized choices become part of the conditioning: a hand holding a cup constrains where the next action begins.
This asymmetry motivates studying whether these tasks should receive independent adaptation.
blocks.zh:
因此,打开和随后的块解决了不同的条件性任务.
在开场时,生成器选择如何通过姿势,位置和初始运动实现参考外观.
在继续期间,这些已实现的选择成为条件的一部分:握起杯子的手会制约下一步行动的开始。
这种不对称现象促使人们研究这些任务是否应独立适应。

blocks.en:
Autoregressive diffusion and student-rollout training make generated history available during learning [ 4 , 5 ] .
Self Gradient Forcing (SGF) also lets later predictions supervise the computations that write this history [ 6 ] .
SGF+ separates denoising and context-writing parameters to accommodate differences between their gradient contributions [ 7 ] .
This is an operation-based partition: each operation shares parameters across the entire stream.
We investigate a temporal-role partition at the same two-adapter budget, grouping generation and writing by whether they establish or continue a scene.
The distinction concerns which computations learn together ( Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
自动传播和学生推广培训在学习过程中提供了创造的历史[4,5]。
Self Gradient Forcing (SGF) 也允许后期预测监督写出这个历史的计算 [6].
SGF+分离了去名和上下文写参数,以适应其梯度贡献之间的差异[7].
这是一个基于操作的分区:每个操作在整个流中共享参数.
我们调查一个时间作用 分配在同一两个适应预算, 分组生成和写 他们建立或继续一个场景。
区别涉及如何共同计算(图1)。

blocks.en:
We introduce TaoMate-R1 , which implements temporal role specialization with an opening adapter at absolute chunk zero and a continuation adapter for every later chunk.
Within each role, denoising and context writing share the same low-rank parameters on a frozen backbone.
Instruction changes update the continuation conditions while preserving its adapter and generated history.
We train both roles with SGF: historical-context gradients return to the role that wrote the corresponding representation.
The opening role thus learns both the first chunk and its persistent video anchor; the continuation role learns subsequent predictions and recent audiovisual context.
blocks.zh:
我们引入 TaoMate-R1, 它执行时间作用的专业化, 开口适配器在绝对块零, 以及后续每个块的续接适配器。
在每个角色中,去名和上下文书写在被冻结的骨干上共享相同的低等参数.
指令修改在保留其适配器并生成历史的同时更新续作条件.
我们用 SGF 来训练这两个角色:历史-文字梯度回到写相应代表的角色.
因此,开场角色既学习了第一块块,也学习了持续的视频主播;继续角色学习了后来的预测和最近的视听背景。

blocks.en:
We characterize this design through a local analysis of parameter sharing.
At a common initialization and fixed replay, the two partitions preserve the same common gradient component but admit different specialization directions.
The analysis also isolates continuation-only windows, where the comparison depends on alignment between continuation’s generation and writing gradients.
These relations describe the optimization consequences of tying parameters and provide a precise basis for comparing the two assignments.
blocks.zh:
我们通过对参数共享的局部分析来描述这个设计.
在共同初始化和固定回放时,两个分区保留了相同的共同梯度组件,但承认不同的专业化方向.
分析还隔离了仅限续作的窗口,其中的比较取决于续作生成和写出梯度之间的相接.
这些关系描述了捆绑参数的优化后果,为比较这两项任务提供了确切的基础.

blocks.en:
Our experiments compare TaoMate-R1’s Temporal split with Shared and Operation split on the same H3 backbone.
Across 32 cases, TaoMate-R1 achieves higher mean CLIP and DINO temporal similarity than Operation split on short interactions, long instruction-driven streams, and public reference compositions.
The clearest difference occurs at instruction boundaries in ten approximately two-minute streams: TaoMate-R1 has a mean luminance jump of 0.613, compared with 1.96 for Operation split, and higher adjacent-frame feature similarity.
We examine these differences with case-paired statistics and background-appearance visualizations, then place the generator’s results alongside external reference-conditioned systems.
The contributions are: ▶ \blacktriangleright TaoMate-R1, a streaming multi-reference generator that assigns independent adapters to scene establishment and continuation, shares denoising and context writing within each role, and trains them jointly through SGF. ▶ \blacktriangleright A local gradient characterization of temporal and operation-based sharing, including the dependence on generation–writing alignment in continuation-only training windows. ▶ \blacktriangleright A comparison across 32 multi-reference cases showing higher mean temporal similarity across three interaction settings and reduced instruction-boundary discontinuities on long streams.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验将 TaoMate-R1 的 Temperal 分裂与 共享和运行分裂 在同一 H3 骨干上。
在32个案例中,TaoMate-R1在短相互作用、长指令驱动流和公共参考构成上实现了比操作分裂更高的平均CLIP和DINO时间相似性。
最明显的区别发生在十道大约两分钟的分界线: TaoMate-R1的中亮度跳跃为0.613分,而Operation分出时为1.96分,相邻的更高方格特征相近.
我们研究了这些与个案统计和背景可视化的区别,然后将生成器的结果与外部参考系统放在一起。
贡献为:\\\\ blacktriangleright TaoMate-R1,是一款流式多参考生成器,负责指派独立的适配器到场景建立和续作,在每个角色内部共享发音和上下文写作,并通过SGF联合培训. \\ 黑三角右转 基于时间和操作的共享的局部梯度特征,包括依赖仅持续培训窗口中的生成-写对接. \\ 黑三角右转 对32个多参考案例进行比较后发现,在三种互动环境中,平均时间相似性较高,长流的教学边界不连续性减少。

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Reference images specify visual attributes and associate them with entities.
ConsisID separates facial structure from identity detail [ 8 ] ; Video Alchemist binds reference features to entity words [ 9 ] ; and Movie Weaver combines prompt anchors with reference-order embeddings [ 10 ] .
Phantom aligns visual and textual reference representations [ 1 ] , VACE integrates image, video, and mask conditions [ 2 ] , and MiniMax-H3 supports multi-reference audiovisual generation [ 3 ] .
Spatiotemporal control specifies where and when these entities appear: DreamVideo-2 uses bounding-box trajectories [ 11 ] , AlcheMinT uses interval-dependent rotary embeddings [ 12 ] , and MultiShotMaster combines shot-aware encoding with reference grounding [ 13 ] .
For interactive streams, FlowAct-R2 aligns evolving conditions with planned behavior [ 14 ] , while ReferStream introduces arriving subjects through contextualized reference latents and cache injection [ 15 ] .
These methods organize visual conditions; our study concerns the adaptation parameters used to realize them across an ongoing scene.
blocks.zh:
参考图像指定了视觉属性并将其与实体关联.
ConsisID 将面部结构与身份细节区分开来 [8]; Video 炼金术将参考特征绑定在实体词上[9];而"电影维弗"将即时锚与参考-顺序嵌入[10].
幽灵将视觉和文字的参考表述相协调 [1],VACE整合了图像,视频,和口罩条件[2],而MiniMax-H3支持多参考视听生成[3].
Spatiotemporal control指定这些实体出现的地点和时间: DreamVideo-2使用边框-box轨迹 [11],AlcheMinT使用间隔依赖的回转嵌入 [12],而MultiShotMaster结合了shot-aware编码与参考地平面 [13].
对于互动流,FlowAct-R2将不断变化的条件与计划的行为相配合[14],而ReferenceStream则通过上下文的参考潜入和缓存注入引入了到达对象[15].
这些方法安排了视觉条件;我们的研究涉及在目前情况下实现这些条件的适应参数。

blocks.en:
Diffusion Forcing uses token-wise noise levels for causal generation [ 16 ] ; CausVid distills a bidirectional teacher into a few-step causal model [ 4 ] ; and SkyReels-V2 extends videos with nondecreasing frame-wise noise schedules [ 17 ] .
History retention supplies persistent appearance and recent motion: StreamingT2V combines initial-chunk cues with preceding-chunk features [ 18 ] , FramePack compresses context according to historical importance [ 19 ] , and LongLive combines a frame sink with local attention [ 20 ] .
LongLive-RAG retrieves earlier latents [ 21 ] , while FilmWeaver separates cross-shot keyframes from recent within-shot memory [ 22 ] .
Training with generated predecessors addresses the context distribution encountered at inference, from Scheduled Sampling [ 23 ] to Self Forcing’s student rollouts [ 5 ] and Rolling Forcing’s jointly denoised windows [ 24 ] .
SGF additionally propagates supervision through historical context writers [ 6 ] .
We adopt this training framework and study parameter sharing under a fixed history-retention policy.
blocks.zh:
分泌活化会使用符号式的噪声水平来进行因果生成[16];CausVid将双向老师分馏成几个步骤的因果模型[4];而SkyReels-V2则将视频以非减速框式的相框式噪声表扩展[17].
历史保留提供了持续的外表和最近的动议: 流出T2V结合了初始-通克提示和前通克特征 [18],FramePack根据历史重要性压缩上下文 [19],而LongLive结合了帧槽与局部关注 [20].
LongLive-RAG取回了更早的潜想 [21],而FilmWeaver则将跨镜头键框与近期的相机内存相分离 [22].
与创造出来的前辈进行的培训涉及在推论中遇到的背景分布,从排行榜抽样[23]到自强的学生推出[5]和滚出自强联合解禁窗口[24]。
SGF另外通过历史背景作者传播监督[6].
我们采用这种培训框架,并根据固定的历史保留政策研究分享参数。

blocks.en:
Specialization allocates independent parameters to computations with different learning demands.
DreamVideo composes identity and motion adapters [ 25 ] , while eDiff-I and Wan2.2 specialize denoisers by diffusion-noise interval [ 26 , 27 ] .
SGF+ separates denoising and context-writing parameters to address gradient differences between these operations [ 7 ] .
TaoMate-R1 groups the same operations by temporal role, using independent low-rank adapters [ 28 ] for scene establishment and continuation.
Our comparison with operation-based sharing holds the two-adapter budget fixed and examines the resulting generation and continuity measurements.
blocks.zh:
专门化将独立参数分配给具有不同学习需要的计算.
DreamVideo编曲身份和运动适配器[25],而eDiff-I和Wan2.2则通过扩散-噪声间隔来专门出演Denoisers [26,27].
SGF+分离了去名和上下文写参数,以解决这些操作之间的梯度差异[7].
TaoMate-R1按时间角色分组相同的操作,使用独立的低等适配器[28]进行场景建立和续作.
我们与基于业务的共享进行比较后,将确定两个调整后的预算,并审查由此产生的生成和连续性计量。

SGF trains historical representations on student-generated rollouts [ 6 ] .
Recorded historical latent inputs remain fixed during differentiation, while later losses propagate through their KV-writing computations.
Generation and writing therefore contribute separate paths to the same objective.

blocks.en:
The references and generated history provide different kinds of information.
Reference images identify entities and their appearances; history records how those entities have been realized together in the current scene.
At the opening, the model establishes their spatial arrangement, poses, and interaction state from the supplied conditions.
Continuation inherits this realization and predicts its evolution under the current instruction.
For example, presenting a new object changes the active references while the presenter and room remain part of the ongoing scene.
The temporal role thus follows the stream’s established state: changing an instruction updates the interaction goal while retaining the history from which the next action begins.
blocks.zh:

在开场时,该模型确定了它们的空间安排、构成以及从所提供条件的相互作用状态。
继续继承此实现,并在当前指令下预测其演变.
例如,呈现出一个新的对象会改变活动引用,而显示器和房间仍然是进行中的场景的一部分.
因此,时间作用遵循流的既定状态:改变一个指令可以更新交互目标,同时保留下一个动作开始的历史.

This grouping specifies which learning signals shape the same adaptation.
For establishment, generation realizes the references in an initial scene and writing represents that scene for subsequent predictions.
For continuation, generation evolves the interaction and writing updates the context available to the next chunk.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate 32 cases: ten short person–object interactions, ten approximately two-minute streams with twenty successive instructions each, and twelve public reference compositions from MultiRef-Compass [ 30 ] .
Short and public clips are approximately ten seconds long.
On the H3 backbone, Shared uses one rank-128 adapter for generation and writing across all chunks. Operation split uses two rank-128 adapters, separating generation from writing following SGF+.
TaoMate-R1 implements Temporal split with two rank-128 adapters, separating opening from continuation.
The two splits have the same adapter budget; their grouping of computations is the variable of interest.
All three configurations use the same training cohort, reference inputs, instructions, history-retention policy, and three-evaluation Euler solver.
Short and public cases generate native audio; long cases follow cached teacher-audio trajectories and use end-frame conditions for object-removal segments.
The training cohort contains 2,196 examples of 4–15 seconds, covering 1,969 object-preserving, 119 object-removal, and 108 object-introduction interactions.
Training excludes first- and last-frame image conditions.
For long evaluation streams, each product presentation is followed by removal, with the person-and-scene reference supplied as the removal segment’s end-frame condition.

短片和公开片段长约10秒.
在H3主干线上,"共享"使用一个分级128的适配器,用于所有块的生成和写作. 操作分拆使用两个分级128适配器,将生成与遵循SGF+的写入相分离.
TaoMate-R1 设备 时间分出两个分级128适配器,将开口与续发相分离.
两种分法具有相同的适配器预算;它们的计算分组是利益变量.
所有三个配置都使用相同的训练组,参考投入,指令,历史保留政策,以及三评价 Euler 解析器.
短而公的案件产生本地的音频;长而公的案件遵循缓存的师-音频轨迹,并使用取物部分的末端条件.
培训组包括2 196个4至15秒的例子,包括1 969个保留物体、119个移走物体和108个引入物体的相互作用。
培训不包括第一个和最后一个框架的图像条件。
对于长的评价流程,每一次产品展示之后都是去除,提供人与地参照作为去除部分的末端条件.

blocks.en:
CLIP and DINOv2 measure whole-frame reference similarity and temporal similarity between successive 1 Hz samples [ 31 , 32 ] .
Full-prompt CLIP and ViCLIP assess text alignment; VABench measures realism and five-question case-level visual QA [ 33 ] .
At instruction changes, CLIP and DINO compare adjacent boundary frames; Luma is the absolute difference in their mean grayscale intensity (0–255).
Scores use equal case weights; paired bootstrapping resamples cases while retaining each complete stream and its matched model outputs.
We draw 100,000 paired resamples and report unadjusted percentile 95% intervals.

blocks.en: 4.2 Effect of the Specialization Axis

blocks.en:

blocks.en:
Both two-adapter configurations improve DINO temporal similarity over Shared in every evaluated group.
At the same adapter budget, TaoMate-R1 further increases the temporal means across all three settings, supporting the assignment of adaptation capacity by opening and continuation.
The aggregate score combines twenty-two short or public cases with ten long streams under equal case weighting; the subgroup results show higher temporal means for TaoMate-R1 within each group.
Reference similarity and visual QA vary by setting, indicating that higher temporal similarity does not imply uniformly better reference matching or visual QA.
blocks.zh:

Table 3 compares adjacent frames at the same instruction boundaries in the ten long streams.

Luminance jumps decrease in all ten streams, and CLIP and DINO boundary similarities each increase in nine streams.
These transition-level gains are more consistent across cases than the sequence-level DINO temporal difference.

blocks.en:
An instruction change introduces a new interaction goal while the preceding scene remains the starting state for continuation.
Boundary measurements evaluate the immediate transition from the last frame under one instruction to the first under the next.
Sequence-level temporal scores also include the intervening within-instruction evolution.
Together, they show higher temporal-similarity means over the full streams, with the clearest paired evidence at instruction changes.
The background views in Fig. 3 extend this analysis to retained scene appearance over the complete stream.
These observations support temporal specialization for maintaining scene continuity as interaction goals change.

序列级时间分数还包括干扰内向演化.
它们共同显示在全溪流上具有更高的时间-相似性,在指令变化时具有最明确的配对证据.
Fig. 3中的背景视图将这一分析延伸至整个流上保留场景外观.
这些观测支持在互动目标发生变化时保持场景连续性的时间专业化。

blocks.zh: 4.4 生成质量

The external-system block of Table 1 compares MiniMax-H3 [ 3 ] , VACE [ 2 ] , SkyReels-V3 [ 34 ] , and Phantom [ 1 ] .
For the long cases, these systems generate each instruction segment independently and concatenate the resulting clips; our autoregressive variants retain history across instruction changes.
TaoMate-R1 leads in mean DINO reference similarity, both temporal similarity metrics, realism, and visual QA.
VACE leads in CLIP reference and full-prompt CLIP scores, and MiniMax-H3 in ViCLIP.

TaoMate-R1在平均 DINO 参考相似性中领先,既指时间相近度度度量,现实性,也指视觉QA.
VACE在CLIP参考和全速CLIP分数中领先,而MiniMax-H3在VICLIP中领先.

blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented TaoMate-R1, a streaming multi-reference generator that groups denoising and context writing by scene establishment and continuation, with SGF coupling the roles through generated history.
A local gradient analysis characterizes the directions retained by this grouping and by operation-based sharing.
On the H3 backbone, TaoMate-R1 achieves higher mean CLIP and DINO temporal similarity across the three evaluated interaction settings at the same two-adapter budget.
It also reduces discontinuities at instruction boundaries in long streams.
The resulting comparison makes the specialization axis an explicit design variable in streaming multi-reference generation.
